# Unity Architecture Agents

> AGENTS.md rule set for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Rider AI Assistant, Codex) on Unity 6 projects. Strict MVC for uGUI with stable rule IDs and RFC 2119 keywords, Roslyn analyzers (UA0001-UA0014) that turn mechanical rules into compile errors, and a verify loop (scripts/verify.sh plus a Claude Code Stop hook) that stops an agent from finishing with a broken build. Works with Unity MCP servers and the Unity CLI. Install as a git submodule at `.ai/`. MIT licensed, pre-release, single author, no other users yet.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/sgonzalezrozo/unity-architecture-agents/blob/main/README.md): installation, templates, verify loop, FAQ
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/sgonzalezrozo/unity-architecture-agents/blob/main/AGENTS.md): entry point, architecture invariants, document routing
- [Agent workflow](https://github.com/sgonzalezrozo/unity-architecture-agents/blob/main/architecture/AGENT_WORKFLOW.md): task classification, plan, checklist, Definition of Done
- [Editor tools](https://github.com/sgonzalezrozo/unity-architecture-agents/blob/main/architecture/EDITOR_TOOLS.md): verification with Unity MCP, the Unity CLI or verify.sh
- [MVC](https://github.com/sgonzalezrozo/unity-architecture-agents/blob/main/architecture/MVC.md): Models, Views, Controllers, where a Model lives
- [Analyzers](https://github.com/sgonzalezrozo/unity-architecture-agents/blob/main/analyzers/README.md): Roslyn rules and installation
